issue_context.title: Throw Exception Reading > UInt32 Row Datasets
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

With `pip install polars-u64-idx` write test dataset of 5B rows:
```python
>>> pl.DataFrame({"index": pl.int_range(0, int(5 * 10 ** 9), dtype=pl.UInt64, eager=True)}).write_parquet("5B-row-load-test.parquet")
```

Read with regular polars install, instead of 5B rows there are 5B - u32 max - 1 rows.
```
>>> len(pl.read_parquet("5B-row-load-test.parquet"))
>>> 705032704
```


### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

`polars` is reading only a part of a dataset without warning or exception.

### Expected behavior

`polars` should throw an exception, or warning at minimum. 

### Installed versions

<details>

```
--------Version info---------
Polars:               1.4.1
Index type:           UInt32
Platform:             Linux-6.1.94-x86_64-with-glibc2.39
Python:               3.11.9 (main, Apr 19 2024, 16:48:06) [GCC 11.2.0]

----Optional dependencies----
adbc_driver_manager:  <not installed>
